player_intent: Close articulated glove fingers around rifle grips while preserving the source strafe and arm pose.
acceptance_rule: Source rifles use native rest-relative flex on both hands, less curl on the trigger index, and opposing thumb directions. Finger-only transforms do not accumulate, alter wrists or move the weapon; reload releases the support fingers and grenade/hidden weapon states skip shaping. Existing saved curl and thumb controls remain effective.

nodes.role: Runs the existing finger-only pass after weapon IK

visual_check: Canonical AK/M4 idle, both strafes, accepted fire and recovery from close-up opposing angles. Confirm curled glove fingers and retained trigger index without a wrist/weapon shift.

system_delta.reason: Native rig finger rests flex toward local +Z around +X on both hands; the legacy right-hand negative sign opens rather than closes. Use rest-relative shaping inside the existing finger writer, retaining legacy behavior outside source rifles.
